description: A burst of sparks: count sparks fly out of a point 1 m above the floor within a cone spread degrees wide around straight up, a fifth of them at once and the rest in a burst that fades out over one second; they fall under gravity and air drag, bounce on the floor keeping bounce of their speed, and cool from white through orange and red to dark red as they reach the end of their life (each spark lives between 0.6 × life and life). Animated, 24 fps from frame 1: cook any frame. sparks: the particles with v, age, life, id, pscale and Cd; trails: each spark's path over its last four frames.

speed.label: speed
speed.desc: how fast the fastest sparks fly out (m/s); the others are up to 30 % slower

spread.label: spread
spread.desc: full width of the cone the sparks fly out in (degrees, around straight up)

bounce.label: bounce
bounce.desc: share of its speed a spark keeps when it hits the floor

life.label: life
life.desc: how long the longest-lived sparks glow (s); each lives between 0.6 × life and life

seed.label: seed
seed.desc: random seed of each spark's direction, speed, start and life

aim.note: one emitter point per spark: its direction in the cone (uniform over the cap), its speed (0.7 to 1 × speed) and the frame it is born in (a fifth at frame 1, then fewer and fewer until frame 24)

emit_now.note: at each frame only the sparks born in it emit (one particle each: emit_rate 1/substeps)

heat.note: glow: 1 at birth, 0 at the end of the spark's own life, fading fast at the end

sparks_only.note: the particles: the points no trail polyline uses. Workaround: removeprim(0, prim, 1) in a prim wrangle also deletes points no prim uses (every particle)

trails_only.note: the trail polylines, without the particles

preview.note: both outputs in one picture, for the render

sparks.label: Sparks
sparks.description: The sparks at the current frame: points with v (m/s), age and life (s), id and Cd from white-hot to dark red.

trails.label: Trails
trails.description: Each spark's path over its last four frames as a polyline (curveu 0 at the tail, 1 at the head), coloured like the spark, for streaks.
